source_baseline.inspection_scope: Apple baseline plus directly applied SWEET patches 0001-0018, 0065, and 0078 for platform-path inspection

source_map.sweet_behavior: _start branches to start_first_cpu; boot_args arrive in x0; assembly derives stacks and bootstrap page tables from virtBase, physBase, and memSize before enabling MMU/caches.
source_map.walleye_requirement: Retain generic entry only after a separately specified firmware handoff proves EL1-compatible register, cache, MMU, boot_args, and mapped-image preconditions; remove SWEET framebuffer writes.
source_map.validation: Assembly/static checks: no WALLEYE hardcoded framebuffer access; generated BA_* offsets match boot_args; entry contract fixture rejects unknown states.

source_map.sweet_behavior: Consumes revision/version, virtBase, physBase, memSize, topOfKernelData, video, deviceTreeP/length, command line, flags, and memSizeActual.
source_map.walleye_requirement: Define an offline-validated producer contract without implementing a shim; every pointer/range must be bounded and reservation-aware.
source_map.validation: Host fixtures validate field widths, overflow, containment, alignment, and non-overlap; no address is selected by the plan.

source_map.sweet_behavior: Copies boot_args, initializes early Platform Expert and topology, constructs VM, starts diagnostics, performs late platform/interrupt/timebase initialization, then enters machine_startup.
source_map.walleye_requirement: Preserve ordering while inserting fail-closed validation before topology, VM ownership, interrupts, or diagnostics consume unverified properties.
missing: which validations can execute safely before final VM
source_map.validation: Source-order test asserts validation hooks precede consumers; host model tests each precondition.

source_map.sweet_behavior: Initializes SecureDT from boot_args and calls pe_identify_machine before VM; late call initializes interrupts/debug.
source_map.walleye_requirement: Consume a documented Apple-style tree whose identity, ranges, CPU nodes, GIC properties, and chosen data were validated offline.
source_map.validation: Schema/golden-tree validation; malformed/missing property fixtures must fail before MMIO mapping.

source_map.sweet_behavior: Matches SweetPlatformExpert on xiaomi,sweet and SweetCPU on qcom,kryo470.
source_map.walleye_requirement: Add distinct WalleyePlatformExpert/WalleyeCPU matches; do not broaden or reuse SWEET identities.
source_map.validation: Text/config test proves SWEET strings are absent from WALLEYE match entries and exact new identities are schema-owned.

source_map.sweet_behavior: Bypasses Apple NVRAM assumption, publishes CPU and top-level DT nubs, and returns SWEET product identity.
source_map.walleye_requirement: Replace with WalleyePlatformExpert using the reusable IODTPlatformExpert nub flow but walleye identity and an allowlist/exclusion policy tied to validated nodes.
missing: which runtime nodes are safe to publish
source_map.validation: Host registry model tests allowlist/exclusion and rejects unknown MMIO-bearing nodes.

source_map.sweet_behavior: Enumerates /cpus, reads reg as physical ID, derives clusters, and SWEET clamps cpus to eight with opt-in default one.
source_map.walleye_requirement: Reuse generic parser only after a verified mapping from FDT CPU reg/MPIDR and cluster properties; keep default boot-CPU-only until SMP evidence exists.
source_map.validation: Synthetic topology fixtures reject duplicates, gaps, absent boot CPU, invalid clusters, and count mismatch.

source_map.sweet_behavior: Assumes Kryo 470 MPIDRs, boot MPIDR zero, PSCI SMC64 CPU_ON, SGI1, and a homogeneous eight-core view.
source_map.walleye_requirement: Replace rather than rename; WalleyeCPU must consume resolved topology and an abstracted, validated firmware CPU_ON service. No secondary startup until conduit/version is known.
source_map.validation: Compile-only interface tests plus mocked firmware return-code/state-machine tests; boot-CPU-only mode must contain no SMC.

source_map.sweet_behavior: PSCI entry assumes x0 context, MMU/caches off, performs EL2 setup, then enters LowResetVectorBase.
source_map.walleye_requirement: Do not reuse until firmware entry EL and reset state are proven; create a separate WALLEYE path only from a written contract.
source_map.validation: Static instruction/register-state contract test against explicit fixtures; unresolved contract disables build-time SMP feature.

source_map.sweet_behavior: Maps DT /arm-io/gic regions, scans redistributors by MPIDR, programs Group 1 NS, SGI1 and timer PPI, and enables ICC system registers.
source_map.walleye_requirement: Reuse DT mapping and redistributor scan with configuration changes; isolate security/group programming behind a policy that refuses unknown ownership.
source_map.validation: Mock-MMIO model validates bounds, stride, affinity matching, timeout paths and no writes while policy is unknown.

source_map.sweet_behavior: Reads ICC_IAR1_EL1, dispatches timer INTID, SGIs and other IRQs, and writes ICC_EOIR1_EL1 under the SWEET Group 1 assumption.
source_map.walleye_requirement: Parameterize IRQ-versus-FIQ/group path only after security/routing evidence; retain timer/IPI separation and bounded spurious handling.
source_map.validation: Pure dispatch tests cover spurious 1020..1023, timer, SGI, device IRQ, EOI order and unknown-policy rejection.

source_map.sweet_behavior: Initializes per-CPU XNU timebase state after platform interrupt setup; virtual timer operations are supplied by ARM64 machine routines.
source_map.walleye_requirement: Directly reuse architecture-generic bookkeeping once CNTFRQ, CNTV access, INTID 19 routing and interrupt delivery are validated.
source_map.validation: Host arithmetic/deadline tests and compile-only ARM register wrapper tests; hardware enable remains gated.

source_map.sweet_behavior: Late PE_init_platform maps interrupt/timer nodes; PE_init_cpu calls pe_init_fiq; generic timebase ops are installed.
source_map.walleye_requirement: Preserve call ordering but replace assumed Apple DT node shapes with the validated walleye ADT schema.
missing: safe mapping point for validated absolute MSM8998 addresses
source_map.validation: Source-order and golden-tree tests; invalid region sizes fail before ml_io_map.

source_map.sweet_behavior: Uses boot_args physBase/memSize/topOfKernelData for managed RAM, physmap, avail_start and page tables; SWEET adds a framebuffer mapping and large-memory padding.
source_map.walleye_requirement: Remove SWEET framebuffer mapping; accept only a reservation-reconciled managed-memory contract. Do not use the runtime FDT declaration as a loader-safe range.
source_map.validation: Host range-set model proves managed pages exclude kernel, ADT, boot_args and every resolved reservation; overflow/overlap tests.

source_map.sweet_behavior: Initializes the XNU physical map from the dynamic-memory boundary computed by arm_vm_init.
source_map.walleye_requirement: Directly reuse only after arm_vm_init receives a correct managed range; no MSM8998 addresses belong here.
source_map.validation: Range-model tests plus compile-only call-boundary assertion.

source_map.sweet_behavior: No directly inspected SWEET/XNU platform path was found that imports Linux /reserved-memory children into arm_vm_init's managed ranges.
source_map.walleye_requirement: Define a host-validated translation into boot_args/ADT ownership before VM initialization; fail if any dynamic placement is unresolved.
evidence: direct search of inspected XNU tree
source_map.validation: Negative test: current summary-only descriptor cannot produce a boot memory contract.

source_map.sweet_behavior: Probes sweet-fbcon and platform serial providers; SWEET early path also uses framebuffer 0x9c000000.
source_map.walleye_requirement: Remove all SWEET framebuffer assumptions. Register no provider until UART type/base/clock are evidenced; failure must return no console without touching MMIO.
source_map.validation: Mock provider tests prove unknown diagnostics perform zero MMIO and return failure cleanly.

source_map.sweet_behavior: Uses serial when serial_init succeeds, otherwise console_write_unbuffered.
source_map.walleye_requirement: Reuse fallback structure only when the fallback is proven storage-free and safe; otherwise use a bounded in-memory ring with no MMIO side effects.
source_map.validation: Host ring-buffer bounds/wrap tests and no-provider failure tests.

source_map.sweet_behavior: Adds SWEET and compiles for ARMv8.2-a+crypto plain arm64.
source_map.walleye_requirement: Add a distinct WALLEYE machine config with ISA flags established from MSM8998/Kryo 280 evidence; never copy ARMv8.2 flags without audit.
source_map.validation: Build-definition lint rejects SWEET identifiers/flags and requires an explicit reviewed ISA setting.

initialization_sequence.name: Firmware entry contract validation
preconditions: immutable contract supplied by future handoff producer

initialization_sequence.name: Early diagnostics selection
inputs: validated UART descriptor or bounded memory ring
outputs: diagnostic sink or explicit no-sink state

initialization_sequence.name: Secondary CPU bring-up
preconditions: PSCI/conduit and secondary entry contract resolved
firmware_services: validated PSCI CPU_ON or evidenced replacement
offline_invariants: feature disabled while firmware contract unknown

compatibility.reason: Host-only bounded tooling has no SWEET hardware dependency.
Core flow is generic; SWEET framebuffer code must be removed and firmware preconditions remain blocked.
ABI can be reused only with a validated producer/range contract.
Identity and node policy target Redmi Note 10 Pro.
Mechanism is reusable with a walleye allowlist and no Apple NVRAM assumption.
MPIDR layout, CPU model, homogeneity, boot CPU and PSCI assumptions are unverified for walleye.
Can consume verified ADT CPU records after topology evidence exists.

compatibility.component: GICv3 DT mapping and redistributor scan
compatibility.reason: Addresses/stride align, but sizes, affinity and security policy must be parameterized.
Walleye GIC security ownership and delivery path are unknown.
Architecture-generic after external frequency/routing preconditions are satisfied.
Hardcoded 0x9c000000 and geometry have no walleye evidence.
Type, base, clock and readiness are unknown.
Core is reusable, but managed ranges must incorporate complete reservations and remove SWEET mappings.
PSCI version/conduit, entry EL and coherency contract are unknown.

acceptance: unknown ISA flags cannot pass review
blockers: ARM64 Mach-O compiler unavailable in current executor

roadmap.objective: Define and validate the walleye Apple-style DT/boot_args handoff schema without implementing a loader.
acceptance: Linux FDT cannot be declared as XNU handoff ADT

acceptance: logging failure cannot touch unknown MMIO

roadmap.objective: Implement WalleyeCPU secondary bring-up only after firmware and coherency contracts are evidenced.
